headings.style_instructions: Do NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings. Use tracking-tighter for all headers. Mix font-light and font-black weights for high contrast.

colors.instructions: Maintain a strict monochrome premium hardware aesthetic. Avoid any SaaS Blue. Use pure whites for primary text and tinted blacks for backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70 border-b border-white/10. CRITICAL: Never use a fully transparent header over page content.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle noise overlay (SVG filter or background image pattern) on the main body to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Use the 'Grid Borders' pattern for technical specification tables (borders on right and bottom of cells).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient glow. No generic CSS drop-shadows. Use soft drop-shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)] for emphasis.

grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for product showcases. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gap-8. Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 shapes to create asymmetry.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-12, p-24, p-32. The layout should feel luxurious and spacious.
grids_and_layouts.chapters: Numbered manifesto sections (e.g., 01, 02) with massive tracking-tighter numbers overlapping text blocks.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Hero overlay MUST NOT exceed bg-black/50. If image isn't clear, overlay is too heavy.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use 'lenis' (@studio-freight/react-lenis) for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.page_transitions: Use framer-motion AnimatePresence. Pages should fade in and translate-y from 20px.
motion.kinetic_text: Line-by-line masked text reveal for H1s using framer-motion. Wrap words in overflow-hidden divs and animate inner text from y:100% to y:0%.
motion.scroll_reveal: Section entrance animations triggered on scroll using framer-motion whileInView.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. The 'Kinetic Texture' variant: Use react-fast-marquee with massive text-8xl text-transparent border-white/10 outline text.

3d_libraries.hero_moment: Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei to render a subtle rotating abstract 3D TorusKnot or Icosahedron in the background of the Home page hero.
3d_libraries.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle parallax effects on large product images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards against backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have high contrast: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white/50 focus:outline-none.

media.image_rules: No placeholder URLs. Max mobile image height 80vh. Apply optical alignment.

laptop_hero.description: Sleek modern laptop on dark background for Laptops page.

tower_hero.description: Dark close-up of gaming PC cooling system for Towers page.

audio_hero.description: Sleek wireless headphones dark background for Audio page.

video_hero.description: Curved monitor dark background for Video page.

abstract_tech.description: Overlapping dark grey abstract geometric shapes for general backgrounds/hero sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: You have .js files not .tsx files. Write all components and logic using pure JavaScript and JSX (e.g., App.js, Main.js, Laptops.js). Do not use TypeScript.
Set up React Router DOM for client-side routing across Home, Laptops, Towers, Audio, Video pages.
Wrap routes with Framer Motion AnimatePresence for smooth page transitions.
Install required dependencies using yarn: framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis react-fast-marquee @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three lucide-react react-router-dom.
Do not rely heavily on Shadcn HTML-based generic cards. Use pure custom HTML/Tailwind for the heavily art-directed layouts.
Implement the fixed Header with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-black/70. Ensure content does not cut off under the transparent header by adding top padding to the main wrapper.
Home page structure: 3D R3F abstract hero, Kinetic text reveal, 4-bento grid linking to product categories, Marquee, Footer.
Product page structure: Large hero image with framer-motion parallax, Numbered manifesto chapters, Technical specs with Grid Borders.
Implement Kinetic Text Reveal: Split heading text into words, wrap each in an overflow-hidden span, and use framer-motion to slide inner text up from 100% to 0%.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Do not apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Do not center align the app container. NEVER use emoji characters for icons. All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
